title: How it works
lede: From idea to shipped product in three steps.

steps.title: Tell your AI what you want to build
steps.text: "I need a SaaS with login, Stripe billing, and team workspaces."

steps.title: Your AI uses Fonderie's building blocks
steps.text: Instead of writing everything from scratch, your AI assembles proven, secure components — login screens, payment flows, team invites — all wired together automatically.

steps.title: You review and ship
steps.text: The AI generates your product. You review it, customize the design, and deploy. Your backend is secure, your frontend works, and your customers can sign up and pay.
